blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The state weather bureau reported on Sunday that typhoon Queenie (international name: Surigae) has further intensified but is already about to exit the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR). The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said Queenie is now packing a maximum sustained wind speed of 150 kilometers per hour […]...
